name: Pia Ortize
source:
Pia Ortize is your textbook example of a Pollyanna, which happens to be her nickname. She believes the best in everyone and wants to help everyone achieve their maximum potential, so she's always out there to lend a helping hand. As an advocate for several causes, she walks around campus with a sign and talks to anyone who's curious, avoiding initiating an unwanted conversation since she knows those aren't effective. She's well liked among her circles.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20120]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
